verdict.rationale: Fathom documents a public REST API with API-key authentication, available on all plans, plus endpoints for meetings, transcripts, summaries, downloads, teams, users and webhooks, official TypeScript and Python SDKs, OAuth for public apps, a changelog, and rate-limit retry behavior. An llms.txt index is also served. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, write and control operations beyond reading meeting data and managing webhooks and downloads, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a standard path (the probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.
